guide.aliveworkplace.intro: Villagers here do real work. Each page shows one thing in the game and how to do it. Turn the pages with the arrows, the arrow keys or the mouse wheel, or pick a chapter.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.welcome.title: Villagers with real jobs
guide.aliveworkplace.page.welcome.text: Builders put up houses from blueprints, miners dig quarries, farmers farm and guards fight. Workers keep their tools and their work in the chests near their workstation, and most work by day and sleep at night.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.camp.title: No village? Bring settlers
guide.aliveworkplace.page.camp.text: Craft a Settler's Wagon and right-click open ground. Two settlers make camp by a Blueprint Table, with a chest of supplies and a Village Hall to place. The first one is already a builder; give the other a job.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.jobs.title: Give a villager a job
guide.aliveworkplace.page.jobs.text: Most jobs share a vanilla workstation. Stand a villager by it, hold the job's item and sneak-right-click them: sweet berries at a composter make an Orchard Keeper. Hold Shift over a workstation in your inventory to see its jobs.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.status.title: What is a worker doing?
guide.aliveworkplace.page.status.text: A worker's job and what they're busy with float over their head. Sneak-right-click a builder, miner or farmer with an empty hand for the full status and how to stop them.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.table.title: Hire a builder
guide.aliveworkplace.page.table.text: Place a Blueprint Table near a villager without a job: they become a Builder. Villages often have a builder's workshop already. Buy blueprints from the builder; more unlock as they level up.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.place.title: Place a blueprint
guide.aliveworkplace.page.place.text: Hold the blueprint and right-click the ground where the front should go. The whole building shows as see-through blocks, and its gold edge is the front. Sneak-right-click the ground to turn it.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.stock.title: Stock the chests
guide.aliveworkplace.page.stock.text: Put the materials in chests or barrels within 8 blocks of the Blueprint Table. Hold Shift over the placed blueprint: it counts what the chests are still short of.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.build.title: Hand it over
guide.aliveworkplace.page.build.text: Right-click the builder with the blueprint. They clear the site, fetch the blocks and build it by day. A busy builder takes up to 5 more. To have a building taken down, place its blueprint over it and sneak as you hand it over.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.styles.title: Styles and upgrades
guide.aliveworkplace.page.styles.text: Sneak-right-click the air with a blueprint to build it in Stonework, Sandstone, Dark Oak or Cherry, or mirrored. Most buildings have an upgrade: place it over the finished one and only what's new gets built.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.library.title: The Blueprint Table
guide.aliveworkplace.page.library.text: Right-click the table to see every blueprint and what it needs. Get Blueprint copies one onto a Blank Blueprint. Upload a File adds your own .litematic or .schem builds for everyone.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.shapes.title: Your own designs
guide.aliveworkplace.page.shapes.text: A Scan Tool saves something you built as a blueprint: right-click two corners, then sneak-right-click the air. The Shape Planner draws walls, towers, domes and arches as blueprints.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.hall.title: The Village Hall
guide.aliveworkplace.page.hall.text: Craft a Village Hall and put it in the middle of your village. Right-click it to see beds, food, guards, what the workers are waiting for and everyone within 64 blocks. Each morning it posts a quest.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.people.title: Your villagers
guide.aliveworkplace.page.people.text: With a hall, villagers get names, traits and moods. They eat from the village store and like a bed of their own. Click one on the hall's list to make them glow so you can find them.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.requests.title: What the village needs
guide.aliveworkplace.page.requests.text: The hall lists everything the workers are waiting for. Hand it over at a Storehouse, or right-click the Storehouse and click a request to send what you carry straight to that worker.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.storehouse.tex: Craft a Storehouse and put chests near it: a villager without a job becomes its Porter. The porter carries what the other workers make to its chests and leaves them the tools they need.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.villages.title: Villages grow
guide.aliveworkplace.page.villages.text: Villages grow workshops, guard houses, clinics, post offices, kitchens and inns by themselves. With a hall a village ranks up from Hamlet to City and keeps a chronicle of what happened there.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.miner.title: Miner
guide.aliveworkplace.page.miner.text: A pickaxe at a blast furnace makes a Miner. Mark a quarry's two corners with a Quarry Marker and give it to them. Keep pickaxes and torches in a chest near the furnace; they bring the stone and ore back.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.lumberjack.tex: An axe at a fletching table near some trees makes a Lumberjack. They fell the trees within 16 blocks and plant a sapling where each stood. Keep axes and a few saplings in a chest nearby.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.farmer.title: Farmer
guide.aliveworkplace.page.farmer.text: Mark a field's two corners with a Field Marker and give it to a farmer (the villager at a composter). Put seeds in a chest near the composter: they harvest, replant and sow the field.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.orchard.title: Orchard Keeper
guide.aliveworkplace.page.orchard.text: Sweet berries, glow berries or an apple at a composter in your orchard make an Orchard Keeper. They pick everything ripe within 16 blocks: berries and cocoa pods.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.fisher.title: Fisherman
guide.aliveworkplace.page.fisher.text: Hand a fisherman (the villager at a barrel) a fishing rod. They fish near their barrel and bring the catch back. Put a boat in their barrel and they row out onto open water.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.beekeeper.text: A glass bottle or shears by a beehive makes a Beekeeper. A flower at a composter makes a Florist, bone meal a Composter, gravel at a cauldron a Sifter. Hold Shift over a workstation for its jobs.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.carpenter.text: Planks at a crafting table make a Carpenter. When a builder nearby is short of something that can be crafted, like fences or doors, the carpenter makes it from the chests and takes it over.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.chef.title: Chef
guide.aliveworkplace.page.chef.text: Raw food at a smoker makes a Chef. Put the makings in a chest nearby and the chef cooks bread, pies, stews and roasts for the village store.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.mail.title: Mail
guide.aliveworkplace.page.mail.text: Craft a Mailbox and place it: mail for you arrives there. Put items in the top row, write a player's name and press Send. Paper by a mailbox makes a Postman, who carries the parcels.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.shop.title: Your shop
guide.aliveworkplace.page.shop.text: Place a Shop Counter near a villager without a job: they become your Shopkeeper. Open the counter to set what each sale gives and its price, and keep the goods in chests nearby.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.ferry.title: Ferries
guide.aliveworkplace.page.ferry.text: Place Travel Posts in your villages and right-click them to learn them. A villager without a job at a post becomes its Ferryman and sells tickets to your other posts, and rows you there.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.guard.title: Guard
guide.aliveworkplace.page.guard.text: A sword at a grindstone makes a Guard. Put weapons and armor in a chest nearby: the guard takes the best. Guards fight monsters within 24 blocks at any hour, and ride a saddled horse or camel.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.training.title: Patrols and training
guide.aliveworkplace.page.training.text: Mark up to eight spots with a Patrol Map and sneak-right-click a guard with it. A Training Dummy near the grindstone keeps guards sparring. Raise a Rally Banner and enlisted guards follow you.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.nurse.title: Nurse
guide.aliveworkplace.page.nurse.text: A honey bottle at a brewing stand makes a Nurse. Right-click the nurse with an empty hand to get your health back. Nurses also cure the village's ill with honey bottles from their chest.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.trainer.title: Trainer
guide.aliveworkplace.page.trainer.text: Place a Training Post near a villager without a job: they become a Trainer. Right-click them with an empty hand to battle. They rank up as people battle them, from Novice to Master.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.tutor.title: Move Tutor
guide.aliveworkplace.page.tutor.text: A book at a Training Post makes a Move Tutor. Right-click them, pick one of your Pokémon and a move it can't learn by levelling. Click the lesson again to pay and teach it.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.ball_smith.tex: An apricorn at a smithing table makes a Ball Smith. Keep apricorns and copper, iron, gold or diamonds in chests nearby and they make Poké Balls with Cobblemon's recipes.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.trader.title: Pokémon Trader
guide.aliveworkplace.page.trader.text: A Poké Ball at a Shop Counter makes a Pokémon Trader. Right-click them for today's offers, pick one and one of your Pokémon that fits, and click it twice to swap.
guide.aliveworkplace.page.fossil.title: Fossil Scientist
guide.aliveworkplace.page.fossil.text: A fossil at Cobblemon's Fossil Analyzer makes a Fossil Scientist. Hand them a fossil and pay: they revive it while they work, and the Pokémon joins your party.

legend.aliveworkplace.pathfinder.title: Pathfinder
legend.aliveworkplace.pathfinder.lore: There is no road they haven't walked, and few they didn't walk first. Somewhere under the hills a stronghold sleeps, a city of echoes waits, and they know the way to both.
legend.aliveworkplace.old_sage.title: Old Sage
legend.aliveworkplace.old_sage.lore: They have lived alone with their books so long that the forest forgot them. They remember the old tongues, the star charts and the herb lore, and they will teach a village that earns it, once it has answered their riddles.
legend.aliveworkplace.seer.title: Seer
legend.aliveworkplace.seer.lore: They came out of the moonlight one night and knelt in the Chapel as if they had always known the way. They read tomorrow in the stars as others read a ledger, and they are never wrong.
legend.aliveworkplace.power.foretell: Foretells at dawn: whether raiders come that night and from which side, the next festival and market day, and the next day's guest; warns of attacks %s days ahead
legend.aliveworkplace.power.bless_weddin: Blesses weddings at the Chapel: the couple is %s happier for %s days, and their first baby comes within %s days when a bed is free
message.aliveworkplace.seer.dawn: At dawn %s looks to the fading stars and foretells for %s:
message.aliveworkplace.seer.raid: Raiders will come tonight, from the %s.
message.aliveworkplace.seer.no_market: No market day: the village has no Market Square.

chronicle.aliveworkplace.blessed_wedding: %s blessed the wedding of %s and %s at the Chapel
advice.aliveworkplace.seer_raid: The Seer foretells raiders tonight, from the %s
advice.aliveworkplace.seer_raid.how: Post guards on the %s side and see everyone home before dark.
advice.aliveworkplace.seer_calm: The Seer foretells a quiet night
advice.aliveworkplace.seer_days.how: As the Seer foretold at dawn. Stock the store for the feast and have goods ready for the traders.
advice.aliveworkplace.seer_guest.how: The %s will come to %s. Have a free bed in a tier III home and their luxury ready, so they stay.
advice.aliveworkplace.seer_no_guest.how: So the Seer foretold at dawn.
legend.aliveworkplace.merchant_prince.lo: Their fleet went down with every coin they had, and they came ashore with nothing but a crimson coat and a head for numbers. Feed them, and they will make a rich village richer: a bank in the hall, fairs in the square and fair prices on every road.
legend.aliveworkplace.grand_chef.title: Grand Chef
legend.aliveworkplace.grand_chef.lore: A chef who cooked for a week without sleeping and came out of the kitchen with a cake the whole village still talks about. Their banquets fill the tables, the hearts and, before long, the cradles.
legend.aliveworkplace.power.banquet: Every %s days a banquet: %s meals each from the store, everyone who comes %s happier for %s days, and babies twice as often for %s days

legend.aliveworkplace.power.work_songs: Twice a day sings for %s minutes where work is busiest: workers within %s blocks work %s× as fast, everyone who hears is %s happier for the day
legend.aliveworkplace.beastmaster.title: Beastmaster
legend.aliveworkplace.beastmaster.lore: A rancher the pillagers caught and kept in a cage for a season, who talked their own wolves round through the bars. Every guard of theirs walks with a war dog at heel, and the horses they breed outrun the wind.
legend.aliveworkplace.power.war_dogs: Tames a war dog for every guard with %s bones from their chest, in wolf armour from %s armadillo scutes; it follows its guard and fights what they fight, and a lost dog is replaced after %s days

legend.aliveworkplace.golem_smith.lore: A tinkerer who stopped mending golems and started making them. Give them iron and a smithing table, and the village will never lack strong hands again.
legend.aliveworkplace.power.golem_forge: Builds a golem every %s days from the chests by their smithing table, up to one per %s villagers; sneak-right-click them to choose which comes next. Mends golems twice as fast as a Tinkerer

message.aliveworkplace.sage.rumour: A rumour reaches %3$s: an old hermit lives alone in a hut about %1$s blocks to the %2$s. They say the hermit knows the old lore.
message.aliveworkplace.sage.riddle.1: I have cities but no houses, forests but no trees, rivers but no water. What am I?
message.aliveworkplace.sage.riddle.2: I point the way but never walk. What am I?
message.aliveworkplace.sage.riddle.3: I follow the sun all day but never see the sky. What am I?
message.aliveworkplace.sage.riddle.4: I have a spine but no bones, and leaves but no branches. What am I?
message.aliveworkplace.sage.riddle.5: I'm full of holes, yet I hold water. What am I?
message.aliveworkplace.sage.riddle.6: Feed me and I live; give me a drink and I die. What am I?
message.aliveworkplace.sage.riddle.7: I run but never walk, and have a bed but never sleep. What am I?
message.aliveworkplace.sage.riddle.8: I sleep under the mountains until a pick wakes me, and then every villager wants me. What am I?

chatter.aliveworkplace.legend_here.0: We have a Legend among us: %s!
chatter.aliveworkplace.legend_here.1: Have you met %s? The whole village is proud.
chatter.aliveworkplace.legend_guest.0: %s is staying with us! Do you think they'll settle?
chatter.aliveworkplace.legend_guest.1: A Legend as our guest: %s. Let's give them everything they need.
chatter.aliveworkplace.legend_strike.0: %s has downed tools. They won't work till they get what they want.
chatter.aliveworkplace.legend_self.0: Yes, I am the %s. Don't let it go to your head; I try not to.
chatter.aliveworkplace.edict_long_shifts: Work till the lamps go out, they say. Every day, they say.
Free bread at the hall! I could get used to this.
The bread's free, but the granary empties fast.
chatter.aliveworkplace.edict_large_famil: Babies everywhere. Somebody has to feed them all.
Big families are lovely, but half of them have a cough.
So many new faces since the gates opened!
Open gates let in guests... and bandits, I hear.
chatter.aliveworkplace.edict_festival_se: Another festival soon! The treasury had better hold.
Festival Season! I've barely put the bunting away.
chatter.aliveworkplace.edict_tithe.0: A tenth of everything to the hall. The prices went up too.
chatter.aliveworkplace.edict_tithe.1: The tithe fills the treasury. Not my purse, mind.
chatter.aliveworkplace.edict_curfew.0: Home by dark, or the watch scolds us.
chatter.aliveworkplace.edict_curfew.1: Curfew's safe, I grant you. Dull, but safe.
chatter.aliveworkplace.edict_conscriptio: I've a sword now, and no idea how to hold it.
If the raiders come, we all drop our tools and fight.
chatter.aliveworkplace.reformed_long_shi: The shift bell's rung. Home we go.
Long days, but the bell tells us when to stop. Fair enough.
chatter.aliveworkplace.reformed_free_bre: The Common Granary keeps the bread coming and the stores full.
Free bread, and nobody goes short. That's a good law.
chatter.aliveworkplace.reformed_large_fa: The midwives keep the little ones well. Bless them.
Big families, and hardly a sniffle since the midwives came.
chatter.aliveworkplace.reformed_open_gat: Guests come in, and the watch keeps the bandits out.
With the Watchful Gate, I sleep easy with the gates open.
chatter.aliveworkplace.reformed_festival: The Festival Fund pays for every party. Wonderful!
Festivals galore, and the treasury doesn't even blink.
chatter.aliveworkplace.reformed_tithe.0: The Fair Ledger keeps the tithe honest, and prices fair.
chatter.aliveworkplace.reformed_tithe.1: I don't mind the tithe now the books are open.
chatter.aliveworkplace.reformed_curfew.0: The lamplighters keep the streets bright. No more hiding indoors.
chatter.aliveworkplace.reformed_curfew.1: Safe nights, and I can still take an evening stroll.
chatter.aliveworkplace.reformed_conscrip: We drilled all winter. Now only those near the fight drop their tools.
The militia knows its drill. The rest of us keep working.
chatter.aliveworkplace.rush.0: The horn's blown! Faster, everyone, faster!
chatter.aliveworkplace.rush.1: A rush today. I'll be worn out by tonight.
chatter.aliveworkplace.tonic.0: That %s put a spring in my step!
chatter.aliveworkplace.tonic.1: One sip of %s and I could work all day.
chatter.aliveworkplace.guild.0: Proud to be one of the %s.
chatter.aliveworkplace.guild.1: The %s look after their own. Better tools, better pay.
chatter.aliveworkplace.class_rose.0: We've come up in the world, and the whole village knows it.
chatter.aliveworkplace.class_rose.1: Folk nod to us in the square now. We earned that.
chatter.aliveworkplace.class_rose.2: New standing, same hands. Still, it feels good.
chatter.aliveworkplace.class_fell.0: We've come down in the world. Don't look at me like that.
chatter.aliveworkplace.class_fell.1: Hard times. We'll climb back, you'll see.
chatter.aliveworkplace.class_fell.2: Fewer friends at the well since we came down.
chatter.aliveworkplace.colours.0: Have you seen our banner? Those are our colours.
chatter.aliveworkplace.colours.1: Our colours fly over the hall. Makes a village feel like home.
advice.aliveworkplace.edict_slot.how: Edicts a %2$s may still put in force: %1$s. Proclaim one on the hall's Edicts page: each gives the village a boost at a cost.
advice.aliveworkplace.reform_step.how: %s waits on the Quests page: %s. Finish every step and the edict loses its cost.
advice.aliveworkplace.festival_fund: The treasury can't pay for the next festival (%s of %s emeralds)
advice.aliveworkplace.festival_fund.how: Festival Season makes every festival cost emeralds. Fill the treasury (taxes, the tithe, the market), or the festival is called off and the villagers are disappointed.
advice.aliveworkplace.guildhall.how: A chartered guild gives no perks until a builder finishes a Guildhall in the village. Give a builder the Guildhall blueprint.
advice.aliveworkplace.cradle.how: Put a Cradle near a bed: children grow up faster there, sleep in it at night, and the village may have an extra baby a day.
advice.aliveworkplace.harvest_idol: Harvest season, and no Harvest Idol by the fields
advice.aliveworkplace.harvest_idol.how: In autumn a Harvest Idol makes the crops within 32 blocks of it grow faster. Set one near the fields round the hall.
aliveworkplace.config.builderRepairs.too: Idle builders repair the buildings they finished when blocks go missing.
aliveworkplace.config.marketDays.tooltip: A village with a Village Hall and a Market Square holds a market once a week.
aliveworkplace.config.villageRaids.toolt: Monsters raid bigger villages with a Village Hall at night now and then.
aliveworkplace.config.banditCamps.toolti: Bandits make camp near villages of Village rank or more now and then, and raid them until their chief falls.
aliveworkplace.config.festivals.tooltip: Villages with a Village Hall hold a festival every season. Players can still call one with a cake.
aliveworkplace.config.nurseHealingMachin: A nurse working at Cobblemon's Healing Machine puts your team in it to heal them (free), and keeps it charged while she's on shift. Off: she heals your team by hand, as at any station.
aliveworkplace.config.berryBreeders.tool: With Cobblemon: sneak-right-click a villager by a composter with any berry and she breeds new berries from the village's own, planting the parent pairs side by side. Off: no Berry Breeder job, and breeders already hired stand idle.
aliveworkplace.config.campCooks.tooltip: With Cobblemon: sneak-right-click a villager by a Campfire Pot with Hearty Grains and she cooks Cobblemon dishes in the pot from the chest beside it. Off: no Camp Cook job, and cooks already hired stand idle.
aliveworkplace.config.habitatKeepers.too: With Cobblemon: sneak-right-click a villager by a Pasture Block with a honey bottle and she keeps the wild Pokémon round it, with snacks set out and Saccharine logs slathered with honey. Off: no Habitat Keeper job, and keepers already hired stand idle.
aliveworkplace.config.gemGrowers.tooltip: Sneak-right-click a villager by a stonecutter with an amethyst shard and she tends the gem beds round it: amethyst, and with Cobblemon tumblestones and Type Gems. Off: no Gem Grower job, and growers already hired stand idle.
aliveworkplace.config.daycareKeepers.too: Sneak-right-click a villager by a Pasture Block with an egg and she keeps one pair of Pokémon per player, finding their eggs at dawn (with Cobblemon). Off: no Daycare Keeper job, and keepers already hired find no eggs.
aliveworkplace.config.habitatSightings.t: Habitat Keepers tell the village of the shiny, rare and Alpha wild Pokémon they spot near their pasture, and write them in the chronicle. Off: they keep their sightings to themselves.
aliveworkplace.config.villageHabitats.to: With Cobblemon 1.8, an Expert Habitat Keeper puts one Habitat Block under the centre stone of a finished Habitat Garden, with Pokémon that suit the biome. One per village; taking the garden down removes it. Off: no village gets one.
aliveworkplace.config.pokemonVillageHous: With Cobblemon, villages sometimes grow a Pokémon Center, a Camp Kitchen, a Berry Nursery, a Daycare and a Gem Grotto, each with its worker already in the job. Off: new villages don't grow them (from the next server start).
aliveworkplace.config.partnerShows.toolt: Pokémon pastured near a workstation are seen helping: they walk over to the work, carry things and lend a hand (with Cobblemon).
aliveworkplace.config.villagerChatter.to: Villagers near a player now and then say something about their day, over their heads.
aliveworkplace.config.villagerCouples.to: Villagers court, marry (a wedding at the bell) and mourn.
aliveworkplace.config.villageTreasury.to: Villages with a Village Hall put by takings every morning for players to collect at the hall.
A Village Hall's owner may protect the village from other players (a setting on the hall, off until they turn it on).
aliveworkplace.config.maxWorkPace.toolti: How fast all the bonuses together (Pokémon partners, a well-kept village, research, traits, a happy mood, edicts) can make a worker, in percent of the usual pace: 200 is twice as fast. Sickness and bad moods still slow them after that; a worker's level doesn't count.
aliveworkplace.config.villageEdicts.tool: A village's owner may proclaim edicts at the Village Hall: laws with a boost and a cost, such as Long Shifts. Off: none can be proclaimed and those in force do nothing, but they stay saved and come back when it's on.
aliveworkplace.config.villageBanners.too: A Village Banner (any banner and a gold ingot) right-clicked on a Village Hall makes its design the village's colours. Off: none can be crafted or set; colours already set stay saved.
